messages:
anya: Morning — quick async check. Started onboarding the new 7B-quant model into staging evals yesterday. Most evals pass but summarization rouge fell ~4% vs current prod on prompt-set-3. No infra errors. Anyone who touched prompt-set-3 recently?

sam: I tweaked prompt-set-3 last week to add the explicit 'TL;DR' anchor. Could that explain the drop? :thinking_face:

mike: Possible. Can you paste an example pairing (prompt + reference) that failed? Also did you run with the same temperature/decoding params?

anya: Example below (redacted):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the following thread in 2 sentences:" + content-block
Reference: "X did Y because Z..."
Model run: tends to add extra context and loses the core sentence.
Config: temp=0.0, top_k=50, max_tokens=120
```

lina: I did a small wording change from "Summarize" -> "Write a 2-sentence summary:" in prompt-set-3. That was to reduce hallucinations on the QA set. I can revert locally and re-run quick evals.

sam: If revert, let's run both versions against the same eval shards to quantify. I can spin up faster batch on dedicated queue.

dev-bot: CI: evals/staging/7b-quant completed — 63 tests run, 58 passed, 5 regressed. Logs: https://ci.internal/evals/7b-quant/1801234567 :white_check_mark:

mike: The 5 regressed tests look like the summarization family. Can we run a diff of tokenization? Sometimes quantization + tokenization rounding causes truncation. Run: `python infra/token_diff.py --model 7b-quant --input examples/summary.json`

anya: Good call. Running token diff now. Also will try lina's revert and post quick numbers.

jordan: Heads-up — I left a small CR on the model onboarding PR (annotations + README). If we need to rollback prompt changes, we should coordinate the PR sequence so staging matches code.

lina: Revert results: ran 200 shard samples, rouge restored to within 0.5% of prod on that subset. No new regressions on QA.

sam: Nice. Can we A/B rollout in staging with traffic-split 90/10 to validate on more samples? I'll set the rollout policy.

mike: Before that, anya, what's the KV-cache warmup behavior for this quant model? If caching differs it can affect long context summaries.

anya: KV warmup seems identical per the runtime traces I pulled. Batching patterns similar. Token diff showed one example where a rare unicode char was being tokenized to two tokens in the quant build; patched tokenizer mapping fixed that locally.

dev-bot: Deploybot: created canary rollout 7b-quant:v2 -> staging (10%). Link: https://deploy.internal/canary/1801234567 :rocket:

jordan: I'll merge onboarding PR once the canary has 30m of telemetry with no perf regressions. Also pinged infra for extra logs retention for the next hour.

anya: Thanks all — action items: (1) lina to keep prompt revert branch ready, (2) sam to run 90/10 A/B and monitor rouge/precision, (3) mike to validate tokenizer patch + run token diff on full failing set, (4) jordan to hold CR merge until canary settles. I'll post a summary in the thread when we have 30m metrics. :thumbsup:
